# ADR-3247: AWS s3: S3 versioning required key for backup bucket 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Versioning enables recovery from ransomware deletes.

## Decision

Backup buckets SHALL include an S3 versioning required key for backup bucket 7 (AWS-s3-7).

## Consequences

Lifecycle policies control cost.
